en.headline: Taking your blood pressure at home
body: Sit down and rest for 5 minutes first.
Keep your feet flat and your arm on the table.
Take it at the same time each morning.
Write both numbers in your blood pressure book.
en.passage: Rest for five minutes before measuring. Sit with your back supported, feet flat on the floor and arm resting on a table

ms.headline: Ambil tekanan darah di rumah
body: Kaki rata di lantai, tangan di atas meja.
Ambil pada waktu yang sama setiap pagi.
Tulis kedua-dua nombor dalam buku tekanan darah anda.
ms.passage: Rest for five minutes before measuring. Sit with your back supported, feet flat on the floor and arm resting on a table

zh.headline: 在家量血压
body: 每天早上同一个时间量。
把两个数字都写进您的血压本。
zh.passage: Rest for five minutes before measuring. Sit with your back supported, feet flat on the floor and arm resting on a table
